entries.title: Custom races gain Jinyu, Sethrak, Gnoll and Saberon with updated appearances
entries.body: Added races receive four racials, improved armor and extra customization. Existing Saberon characters migrate to the Alliance race ID.

entries.title: Optional custom races support extended character appearances
entries.body: Server owners can enable custom races when players have installed the matching client patches.

entries.title: Optional custom playable races support (mod-coa-custom-races)
entries.body: Added optional custom playable races support with isolated DBC overlays in Data/dbc_races/, extended appearances protocol support, and configuration toggle via CoACustomRaces.Enable (disabled by default).

entries.title: Server packages include the optional custom race module and its game data
entries.body: Custom races require the matching client patches and can be switched on in the Manager.

entries.title: The experimental Linux server build matches the Windows release contents
entries.body: Experimental. The Linux package now includes SQUID Playerbots, the launcher scripts and the release database checks, and carries the prepared databases the Docker installer imports.

entries.title: Server packages include the updated custom race game data
entries.body: Install the matching client patches through the Manager before enabling custom races.

entries.title: Linux: install from the install screen, play with Wine or Proton (experimental)
entries.body: Experimental. The install screen offers Docker installs on Linux, realm profiles and the Play button work on a Docker server, and updates are not offered for it.

entries.title: Custom races can be enabled and their client patches installed from Modules
entries.body: Install the custom race client assets from the module card, then enable the module and restart the server.

entries.title: Unsaved settings are protected and crashed servers can restart automatically
entries.body: The Manager asks before leaving unsaved settings. Optional automatic restart pauses after repeated crashes, and crash history explains common failures.

entries.title: Custom race client patches update to the latest races and appearances
entries.body: The module card offers an upgrade for older patches. Archive downloads are verified before installation.

entries.title: A failing database update is no longer reported as "database not running
entries.body: An SQL error whose message contained the number 2003, such as an out-of-range value, was shown as "The database is not running". The real error is now shown.

entries.title: Background world servers no longer stop because the local console is closed
entries.body: The Manager automatically disables the local interactive console before starting the world server. Its remote console remains available, and no manual configuration changes are needed.

entries.title: Server and Bots settings open without a blank window
entries.body: Opening settings no longer crashes the interface after loading. Unsaved changes can still be saved or discarded before leaving the page.
